notes.title: Major Update to 3D Solar System Simulator
notes.content:
Major update to the 3D Solar System Simulator is now available.  New user experience including virtual fly by stick.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41773000/0ce47e72e982c9d0979f27b14b05ce6e8e8e95c4.png[/img]

notes.title: Added Reset button and other UI improvements and fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41773000/5d24405a099bb4a8f0ea3cafe3f1a64f063b517a.jpg[/img]Rev 1.5.2
Fixed scaling issues when adding random planets
Fixed issue with units of days not displaying in Options screen
Added scroll left and right buttons for the planet material chooser screen
Removed Valve.VR throughout
Scaled the Delete planet screen better
Some other minor UI improvements
Added a sim reset button - useful if you have totally lost yourself when flying through the solar system

notes.title: Added better hand models and hand animations
notes.content:
Added better hand models and added hand animations, this is in preparation to then develop virtual throttle and joystick (future update, timing TBC)
Also fixed a few minor bugs

notes.title: Some fixes and added ability to manually increase sim accuracy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41773000/741e15d1b638efa5c5d059d2807a7a5e74043417.jpg[/img]
Fixed issue with calculation of elapsed time.
Fixed issues with display of planet data
Added ability to run multiple sim iterations per frame (instead of just one). If your computer is good enough you can now arc up the sim accuracy.

notes.title: Minor update, Bug FIx, Added Earth/Moon system, and Saturn/Moons system
notes.content:
Corrected issue with scaling of planet name and mass text.
Added Earth <> Moon system
Added Saturn <> Saturn Moons systems (note that Saturn's rings are not yet available....have to think about how to do that!)

notes.title: 3D Solar Sim Update to Rev 1.3
notes.content: Rev 1.3.  Added better rendering and new model for spaceship.  Added Jupiter system / moons with planet rendering.
